blocks.text: Miki Ryoma fired a four-under-par 66 under excruciating heat on Wednesday to take a one-shot lead at the halfway mark of the P2.5 million ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge as he moved 36 good holes away from realizing a dream. The 35-year-old Japanese, who wears a bowtie during tournaments, thus became the first foreigner in the circuit to lead a PGT leg this season, and getting a shot at a breakthrough win like this comes a full decade after he finished second to Antonio Lascuña at Eagle Ridge.
